title: The BMC does not correctly enforce integrity and encryption requirements for IPMI commands. (CVE-2026-18450)
description: A vulnerability in the Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) allows improper enforcement of integrity and encryption requirements for IPMI commands. This flaw enables an attacker to craft malicious packets that could execute arbitrary commands within an active session. The vulnerability has a critical severity rating with a CVSS score of 9.8.
